title: T-slot aluminium profile
description: A 30 x 30 mm B-type aluminium profile with four 8 mm T-slots and a core bore tapped M8 at both ends, cut to length, in clear anodised EN AW-6063.
process: Extrusion, sawing to length, tapping, clear anodising
